appearances.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash identified as Space Bunny
appearances.summary: MiniMax M3.1 Flash, the model behind Space Bunny, is on the API at $0.15/$0.60 per million input/output tokens, with reported scores of DeepSWE 74%, Automation-Bench 62%, and BabyVision 91%. Weights are scheduled for Oct 23. Cline made it free, and OpenCode is offering it free for three days.
